# Original distribution

`original/` contains the supplied release without modifications. Builds use its images, Node.js runtime, and binary RPKG assets. Recovery tools use its executables, bundles, and PRP data as inputs.

Maintain code in `src/`, data in `data/`, and default configuration in `config/`. Do not edit this reference copy. Its file hashes are recorded in `docs/recovery/input-manifest.json`; Git attributes disable newline conversion here.
